description: REFRAME A VIDEO: the same video in another frame, for where it is posted — 9:16 (stories, reels, shorts), 4:5 (a feed post), 1:1 (square) or 16:9 (a landscape master). fit "fit" (default) keeps the whole picture, centred over a blurred fill of itself, so nothing is cut (captions at the top or bottom of a vertical ad stay); "fill" scales to cover the frame and centre-crops the rest (the report says how much of the picture is kept). The sound is kept as it is (a scored film's mix untouched). Up to 1080 px on the short side (never upscaled past the source's), H.264 MP4. A video already in that frame is copied, not re-encoded. Input: video_key (an upload) or video_url (a doseedo_score_to_picture video as returned, or any public https URL). CPU, no credits. Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task. Cancel: a re-frame still queued never starts and one running stops within seconds; either way its credit is refunded and the job ends as canceled.

fit.description: fit (default): the whole picture over a blurred fill, nothing cut. fill: cropped to fill the frame.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

name.description: Optional: a name for this job's files, e.g. "rainy-loop-3". Every file it returns downloads as <name>_<part>.<ext> (rainy-loop-3_Celesta.wav, rainy-loop-3_rough-mix.wav; one take: rainy-loop-3.wav), so the user can find them. Give each job its own name (a second take: "rainy-loop-3b"). Default: doseedo-<last 6 characters of the job id>.

video_key.description: R2 ingest key of the video (from doseedo_get_upload_url).

video_url.description: The video's URL: a doseedo_score_to_picture video as returned, or a public https URL.

name: doseedo_reframe_video
title: Put a video in another frame (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9)
